title: OBI source filter
description: A source is part of the filter if it matches at least one entry.

source-lib.description: Library. With use-regex a regular expression, otherwise a pattern with * and ?. Not case-sensitive.

source-file.description: Source file. With use-regex a regular expression, otherwise a pattern with * and ?. Not case-sensitive.

source-member.description: Source member. With use-regex a regular expression, otherwise a pattern with * and ?. Not case-sensitive.

use-regex.description: The three values are regular expressions.

show-empty-folders.description: Also show libraries and source files without members.
